_comment: players.id -> FPL permanent code, for rows the (web_name, position) key could not match on its own. A null value means REVIEWED AND DELIBERATELY LEFT WITHOUT A CODE: it clears the hard stop for that row without weakening the gate for rows nobody has looked at.

_reviewed_no_code: Anderson: our row is DEF/SUN, the only feed candidate is MID/MCI — a different club AND a different position, so this may well be a different person. Rostered for a single gameweek. Guessing would write another human's permanent id onto a row 12 FK columns point at; if it IS the same player, sync creates a duplicate row later, which is recoverable. Left NULL deliberately.
